title: A charge you did not agree to
instructions: Read the situation and write an email to the person or company indicated. Your email should be 6-10 sentences. Use an appropriate level of politeness.
situation: Last month you rented a car from Coastal Auto Rentals for a weekend trip. The trip itself went well. However, when you collected the car, the staff added an insurance option that you had already declined when you booked online, and it appears on your final bill.
must_include: explain what happened when you collected the car
state what you would like the company to do
ask when you can expect a reply
